title: Hata eneo lililo mbele kabisa ya Chuo Kikuu cha Taylor's lilivutia
label: Mbele ya Taylor's

text.Taylor's University, which I visited on: Chuo Kikuu cha Taylor's nilichotembelea siku ya kwanza ya ziara yangu za vyuo vikuu.
text.It is the university where an Indian stu: Hiki ndicho chuo ambacho mwanafunzi wa India alituzungusha kwenye kampasi yake.
text.This is the campus of Taylor's Universit: Hii ndiyo kampasi ya Chuo Kikuu cha Taylor's.
text.A lawn spreads out, and in the back, you: Uwanja wa nyasi umetandaa, na nyuma unaweza kuona pia ziwa dogo.
text.Really right in front of the Taylor's ca: Mbele kabisa ya kampasi ya Taylor's kulikuwa na mabweni ya wanafunzi na jengo lililofanana na mtaa wa maduka.
text.It is not really a shopping street, but: Kwa kweli si mtaa wa maduka, bali ni jengo angavu lenye atriamu iliyo wazi.
text.There were things like a food court ther: Kulikuwa na sehemu kama eneo la chakula pia.
text.Taylor's University itself was attractiv: Chuo Kikuu cha Taylor's chenyewe kilivutia.
text.And the dorms and buildings right in fro: Mabweni na majengo yaliyo mbele kabisa ya chuo kikuu pia yalivutia sana.
text.In Malaysia, there is a shopping mall th: Nchini Malaysia kuna jengo la maduka linalofanana na piramidi ya Misri, na ndani yake nilipata Jollibee
text.University visit, day 2: Sunway College: Ziara ya chuo kikuu, siku ya 2: Chuo cha Sunway
